name: Mimosa
source:
The main villainess.

She enjoys inflicting pain on others and sadistically toying with her victims until they perish. Her haunting laughter is the last thing her targets hear before they die. Myth and legend have been crafted around her, since no one who's seen her has lived to tell the tale.

[From [url=https://inazumaorder.itch.io/under-the-witchs-trial]itch.io[/url]]
